description: Update a channel set's name and/or channels (partial update — at least one field is required). A name that collides with another set fails with a 409, code DUPLICATE_NAME. Use this when the user wants to rename a channel set or change its channels.

name.description: New set name (max 100 chars, unique per organization).

setId.description: The channel set ID to update.
